title: Phish Residency at Sphere
tagline: Real-time visuals that improvised with the band — a concert experience fans couldn't get anywhere else.

body: Phish is a jam band: songs can run anywhere from 4 to 30 minutes, and fans come precisely because every show is different. The visuals had to honor that — a real-time creative ecosystem that could follow the band live, with original content for 86 songs across four nights, each able to stretch past 30 minutes.
Delivering it meant moving more than 400 terabytes of content from four countries to our onsite servers at Sphere in Las Vegas.

I led creative ideation, production and content delivery, all Unreal development and implementation, and the onsite technical innovation behind the show. The team blended scenographic elements, 360° live performance capture and real-time technology like Unreal and Notch with pre-rendered and AI-generated imagery — always in service of the band's identity, not the technology.

With three agencies — Sila Sveta, Fly Studios and Myreze — plus internal and external artists, we built 12+ hours of pre-rendered, real-time and AI-generated content, and pre-programmed hundreds of looks in Disguise and on a GrandMA2 console that could be layered and played live with the band. It felt like Phish's music made visible — a show fans filmed, shared and relived long after they left.
led: Led creative ideation, production and content delivery
Led all Unreal development and implementation
Oversaw onsite innovation and safe show delivery

impact.note: Four sold-out nights and 80,000 fans in the room — and clips viewed more than 20 million times across social, carrying the experience far beyond the venue.
